title: Drones, Deficits, and Doubt: Bulgaria Confronts War's Shadow and a… · 22 Oct
keywords: Bulgaria, Black Sea, drone attacks, maritime security, NATO, Ukraine war spillover, inflation, cost of living, IMF, fiscal deficit, economic outlook, eastern flank, Sofia, EU, trade unions
notes: Bulgaria is simultaneously navigating a maritime security crisis in the Black Sea and a domestic economic squeeze, as drone attacks on commercial vessels raised fears of war spillover and September inflation climbed to 5.7 percent. Both crises are testing the credibility of Sofia's institutions and the resilience of ordinary households. The combination has produced a public mood oscillating between anxiety and resignation.
